text:
nina: Planning a short coordinated push tonight 20:30-21:00 UTC. Order: api -> runtime -> console -> router. Quiet window. Call out blockers or pinned builds.

omar: runtime team: we're promoting runtime v3.2.1-quant (sha-rt-321q). It advertises X-Runtime-Mode:quant; older routers will 400. Router needs header whitelist update or we pin runtime to 3.1.x.

chloe: console has a tiny copy update. We'll disable FEATURE_BETA for canary. No migrations.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wave 20:35 UTC. Sequence: api=sha-api-222,runtime=sha-rt-321q,console=sha-ui-23,router=sha-router-13. Canary: 10m eu-only at 1% then 10% for 5m. Autorolled back on trigger.

omar: Ops note: we want a prewarm step for runtime KV (internal probe) after api canary and before traffic ramp. deploybot can run /internal/prewarm for 5 minutes.

chloe: Please also mute UX telemetry during canary to avoid noisy alerts.

sre-bot: Staging smoke: all green. p99 api 95ms, p99 runtime 170ms.

nina: Rollback triggers: error rate >1% for 3m OR p99 >2s for 3m OR repeated healthcheck fails. If you want an immediate rollback, reply exactly "rollback" here.

omar: If router header can't be applied within 8m after runtime canary, plan = pin runtime to sha-rt-3109.

deploybot: deploybot: ready to start on "go". Will publish events to #release-notifications and send webhooks to SRE.

nina: Everyone ack monitoring at 20:30 UTC or we move to next window.

omar: Ack (will tail router-13 logs).

chloe: Ack.

deploybot: deploybot: acknowledged.

sre-bot: Alerts and dashboards linked in thread.

nina: Thanks  we'll post start note when kicking off.
